Extreme Weather Events Linked to Climate Change

Extreme weather events globally are increasing in frequency and intensity, with experts linking them to climate change. Reports highlight that regions like Canada are experiencing significant flooding, as seen in Toronto, which underscores a broader risk of severe weather. The phenomenon is further exacerbated by factors such as El Niño, which is described as intensifying and contributing to a global 'extreme weather danger zone'. These events serve as a stark reminder of the growing impact of climate change on various parts of the world.
